question: Who is recognised as the founder of the Lucknow Gharana of Kathak?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ishwari Prasad.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shri Ishwari Prasad ji **as a native of the Handia region in Prayagraj (Allahabad), he was started as the original originator of the** Lucknow Gharana of Kathak dance**. 
 
• Handia is one of the areas whose important** residents have been narrators**.
 
• Kathak is established in three distinct forms, known as** "gharanas"**, named after the cities where the Kathak dance tradition evolved – **Jaipur, Banaras and Lucknow.** 
 
• While the Jaipur gharana focuses extra on the **foot movements**, the Banaras and Lucknow gharanas focus extra on **facial expressions **and **elegant hand movements.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sitara Devi **was an Indian dancer of the **classical Kathak style of dancing.**
 
• **Birju Maharaj​** was mainly famous as a** brilliant choreographer**, and he **helped popularize dance-dramas. **
 
• **Rukmini Devi Arundale** was an Indian **dancer and choreographer** of the Indian classical dance form of **Bharatanatyam.**
